original_test_intent: Validate the BMC POST Code Logs display, search, date/page filtering and single/selected/all export behavior against known boot-cycle records.
original_method: Identify the dedicated POST-code log source, firmware/timezone and boot-cycle boundaries; preserve the complete baseline; use known existing and absent search values; exercise current display, searches, date filter and pagination; export one record, a bounded selection and all records; parse each artifact and compare exact IDs/codes/timestamps/order/boot-cycle membership with the page, without clearing diagnostic evidence unless an isolated fixture explicitly requires it.
manual_activity: The owner supplies POST-code meanings, boot-cycle scope and any safe boot fixture; an operator verifies the BMC page and downloaded artifacts while automation records exact query and export comparisons.
required_inputs: Supported BMC POST Code Log interface/API
Vendor POST-code dictionary and field schema
Known existing and non-existing code/query values
Export format, ordering and duplicate-code rules
Approval for any fixture boot or log mutation
safety_requirements: Do not clear POST, SEL or audit logs for setup by default
Preserve complete baseline exports and hashes
Do not infer dedicated POST records from a filtered SEL grep
Use only approved boot fixture if known records are absent
Validate every exported file rather than trusting UI success
Stop on missing boot context, corrupt export or unrelated log change
Keep main workflow read-only and preserve diagnostic logs
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete POST log and related baseline
Exercise current display, searches, date filter and pagination
Download single, selected and all exports
Parse and compare contents, IDs/codes/times/order and hashes
Review related SEL/audit/host logs without clearing
engineer_actions: Provide code dictionary, boot-cycle scope and expected semantics
Approve any boot fixture or exceptional clearing
Resolve ambiguous code or export mappings

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Filtered SEL output is only optional corroboration; it cannot prove the dedicated POST page, boot-cycle completeness, searches, date/page filters or export contents, and password-in-command-line handling is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported BMC POST Code Logs Web/API path, preserve the complete boot-cycle baseline, execute the stated read/filter actions and parse/hash single, selected and all exports against exact page membership.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All nine POST Code Logs actions and 10/10-minute estimates are retained; no deletion is added and unsafe setup clearing is not treated as required coverage without separate approval.

modernized_recommendation.status: BOOT-CYCLE-BOUND POST-LOG SEARCH AND EXPORT AUDIT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a canonical baseline keyed by boot cycle plus record sequence/code/timestamp, then record each query result and reconcile every downloaded artifact to its requested subset and file hash.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative code semantics, cycle boundaries and export-content proof while preserving the source's Web workflow.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: SEL may not contain the same records or fields; an operator screenshot cannot substitute for machine-verifiable exported membership and hashes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated POST codes are normal during boot and can be lost if the export/parser incorrectly deduplicates; firmware clocks may also reset or change timezone between cycles.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define what constitutes one boot cycle and whether a fixture reboot is needed. If current logs already contain suitable known records, no boot or clear action should be introduced merely for setup.
expected_evidence: Verified target/firmware/timezone, POST source/schema/dictionary, boot-cycle rules and complete baseline hash
Current display and known absent/present search inputs with result IDs/codes/counts
Date-filter boundaries and pagination traversal with full membership proof
Single, selected and all export files with hashes and parsed ID/code/time/order/cycle comparisons
Final POST/SEL/audit/host-log state, no-unapproved-mutation/security audit and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The main Procedure and Criteria consistently define read/search/filter/export validation. Blanket pre-clearing is an unsafe setup instruction that is unnecessary when known records exist and may be separately controlled in an isolated fixture.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The POST schema, dictionary, boot-cycle mapping and Web access are normal vendor/project inputs; the workflow can be reviewed without guessing them.

review_improvement: Restores all Web actions and makes each export auditable against exact boot-cycle membership while preventing setup from destroying the diagnostic source under test.
independent_technical_reasoning: POST codes are an ordered trace, not an unordered set: repeated codes, their sequence and boot-cycle boundary often carry meaning. Search and export correctness therefore require a canonical ordered baseline. A simple SEL grep can miss the dedicated store, and a successful download proves transport only, not that the requested records and order were preserved.
